titles.en: Stele of Shi Chen, original stone

productionDate.note: 后碑刻于建宁元年（168）四月，与前碑同石。

currentCollection.note: One stone carries two texts: the front dated 169, the back dated 168. The record keeps 169 as the main date and states the second date in the source wording.
currentCollection.noteZh: 一石两面：碑阳刻于建宁二年（169），碑阴为建宁元年（168）四月。本条以 169 年为主，另一年保留在原文表述中。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft object record. The collection assertion comes from the cited page but has not been reviewed against the object itself.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：草稿记录。现藏依据来自所引页面，但尚未与实物核对，也未经独立审核。
